title: Personal LLM experiment mini-tracker - Avery - 2026
content:
Mini experiment tracker (personal) - quick rows for benchmarking tweaks and notes

Columns: Date | Exp | Model | Quant | Batch | InputSeq | Throughput (tokens/s) | p50_ms | p95_ms | est_cost_per_1M_tokens | Notes
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2026-01-28 | exp-2026-001 | Llama-3-8B | int8 | 8  | 256 | 12,400 | 34  | 120 | $7.20  | baseline (no KV cache), single-GPU, eager kernel path
2026-02-05 | exp-2026-005 | Llama-3-8B | q4_0 | 16 | 128 | 18,600 | 28  | 95  | $5.00  | enabled prefix/KV cache, continuous batching, lower p95
2026-02-12 | exp-2026-009 | Llama-3-70B | int8 | 4  | 512 | 6,800  | 70  | 240 | $18.40 | heavy mem pressure, observed KV eviction at seq>1024
2026-02-18 | exp-2026-011 | Redwood-7B-v1 | q3_k | 8  | 256 | 14,200 | 40  | 150 | $6.80  | promising cost/throughput tradeoff, needs more runs
2026-02-25 | exp-2026-015 | Redwood-7B-v1 | q3_k | 32 | 64  | 24,900 | 22  | 80  | $4.10  | aggressive batching, watch latency tail for small requests

Quick metrics (personal summary):
- Runs tracked: 5
- Best single-GPU throughput: 24.9k tok/s (Redwood-7B q3_k, batch 32)
- Best cost estimate: ~$4.10 per 1M tokens (same run)
- Lowest p95 observed: 80ms (same high-batch run, but note p95 degrades for small batch requests)

Notes / observations:
- Enabling prefix/KV cache reduces token work for repeated prompts (seen ~35% throughput lift on Llama-3-8B)
- q3_k quant yields best cost/throughput on Redwood-7B in these runs; need to validate quality on eval prompts
- For latency-sensitive routes (interactive chat) prefer batch <=8; use model variant with faster kernel selection
- For high-throughput background jobs, leverage batch 32+ and q3_k for cost savings

Next steps / TODOs:
- [ ] Run quality eval (50 prompts) comparing q3_k vs q4_0 on Redwood-7B (blocking: create eval prompt set)
- [ ] Re-run best-throughput config with seq lengths 32/64/128 to profile small-prompt latency tail
- [ ] Open benchmark PR summarizing cost vs latency tradeoffs for product team (link to draft in linked_artifacts)
- [ ] Add flags to runner to record KV-hit ratio per request (to correlate with throughput wins)

Scratch notes (fast):
- Possible follow-up: try Hybrid routing policy experiment: fast model for interactive, cheap model for background; measure fallback frequency
- Reminder: check infra ticket JIRA-INF-312 for GPU limit changes on dedicated pool

Origin: created as a personal mini-sheet for quick ad-hoc tracking; meant to be informal, shareable with applied-ml and solutions-eng for discussion.
